citation.authors: Reich D, Nalls MA, Kao WH, Akylbekova EL et al

cited_by.title: A low white cell count that may be Duffy-null (neutrophil count)

record.population: 6,005 African Americans from three cohort studies
record.finding: The Duffy Null variant (rs2814778) predicted white cell and neutrophil count in African Americans beyond the previously described admixture association, establishing a new phenotype for the variant.
